# REST API

The API every resource gets, with filters, writes, errors and the typed client.

- [Generated REST API](../reference/api.md#routes): List, get, create, update and delete endpoints for every resource, following the AIP API design guidelines.
- [OpenAPI and reference](../reference/api.md#meta-and-openapi-per-caller): An OpenAPI 3.1 document and an API reference page, each showing only what the caller may see and do.
- [Filters](../reference/api.md#filters): AIP-160 filters and ordering, with full-text search, lists of values and relative dates.
- [Counts, facets and charts](../reference/api.md#routes): Endpoints for value counts, grouped sums and averages, records over time, histograms and paging to any row.
- [Map queries](../reference/api.md#maps): The records inside a map's view, or counts per area when there are many.
- [Related names and photos](../reference/api.md#related-names): A list response can carry the names of related records and each record's first photos.
- [ETags](../reference/api.md#writes): Every record has a version, and a write based on an old version is refused.
- [Minimal responses](../reference/api.md#writes): A create or update can answer without the record, to save the transfer.
- [Batch writes](../reference/api.md#batch-writes): Up to 500 creates, updates, deletes and reorders across resources in one transaction.
- [Record permissions](../reference/api.md#record-permissions): Responses say which records and fields the caller may change.
- [Scan guard](../reference/api.md#safety): Reads that would scan a large table without an index are refused, with the index to create.
- [Statement timeouts](../reference/api.md#safety): Every request's queries stop after 1 second by default, with an error that names the request, and reads run read-only.
- [Errors](../reference/api.md#errors): Every error is a problem document with a stable type and per-field details.
- [Audit events](../reference/api.md#audit-events): Reveals of sensitive values and organization changes are published as audit events.
- [Error reporting](../reference/api.md#error-reporting): Server and admin app errors go to a Sentry-compatible error tracker when a DSN is set.
- [JWT authentication](../reference/api.md#authentication): The API accepts tokens from another identity provider, or a check of your own.
- [CORS](../reference/api.md#cors): Websites on other origins can call the API once their origins are listed.
- [Typed client](../reference/client.md): A typed fetch client and React hooks for the API.
